incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SREs — High GPU pool queue depth detected in us-west1 (pool-a). 503s observed on /v1/generate. Error-rate spike at 12:05 UTC.
Sam D: Ack. I'm on it. Pulling up autoscaler logs and HPA events.
Maria V: Thanks. I'm triaging customer-facing errors and will post impact numbers.
Sam D: Autoscaler events show repeated failed scale-up attempts from 12:03-12:08. HPA scaled to desired 0->8 but pods stayed Pending due to long warmup. Suspect warmup timeouts and GPU resource contention.
Kevin L: I see pods stuck in ContainerCreating with NVIDIA driver waiting. kubelet logs show GPU driver rebinds.
Sam D: Copying relevant logs:
```
kubectl describe hpa/gpu-pool-hpa -n inference
Events:
  12:02: CPUUtilization above target
  12:03: Failed to scale up: timeout waiting for nodes
  12:05: TargetSize 8 -> 12 (requested), but nodes added slowly
```
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep pool-a
inference-xyz Pending   0/1  ContainerCreating  0s
inference-abc Running   1/1  Ready             12m
```
Sam D: Metrics snapshot (queue depth / 1m): 0:12:00 -> 4, 12:02 -> 120, 12:04 -> 450, peaked 12:06 -> 980
Maria V: Customer impact: 17% of hosted API requests in us-west1 returned 503/504 between 12:03-12:12. Top affected customers are mid-market SaaS tenants with bursty gen workloads.
Jane R: Any recent infra deploys? infra-bot, did we push anything to autoscaler yesterday?
infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: Deploy 2026-03-12T22:40 - autoscaler: bump backoff logic change (PR #4821) - rolled to canary and promoted at 03:10 UTC.
Kevin L: That backoff tweak could interact with node-launch timings. Hypothesis: autoscaler backoff prevents timely node requests, HPA requests nodes but autoscaler delays causing slow node provisioning -> pods Pending and warmup not happening.
Sam D: Another data point: vault of GPU images undergoing pull-from-registry rate limiting; image pulls timed out intermittently 12:03-12:07.
Maria V: Summary hypothesis list:
- H1: Autoscaler backoff change caused delayed node provisioning (primary)
- H2: Container image pull rate limits + registry throttling increased pod creation time (contrib)
- H3: Node GPU drivers flapped on some hosts causing kubelet to keep pods Pending (contrib)
Sam D: Actions now:
- Sam D -> collect autoscaler controller logs + event timeline (assigned)
- Kevin L -> check node driver events and kernel logs on affected hosts (assigned)
- Maria V -> assemble customer impact summary & comms (assigned)
- Jane R -> validate whether canary was promoted and revert flag if confirmed (assigned)
Sam D: Running command to fetch autoscaler logs:
```
kubectl logs -n kube-system deployment/autoscaler --since=20m | grep -i 'scale'
```
Sam D: Found lines showing exponential backoff entries starting 12:01 and persisted until 12:09.
Kevin L: Node logs show driver rebinds on node-37 and node-42 around 12:02-12:04, and docker image pull timeouts 12:03:10 -> 12:06:30.
Maria V: Customer impact numbers posted to incident doc: https://redwood-infra.internal/incidents/INC-2026-03-12-gpu-queue
Sam D: Short-term mitigations executed:
- Temporarily increased autoscaler aggressiveness via toggle (manual override) at 12:12 UTC.
- Pre-warmed 4 nodes from spare pool at 12:15 UTC.
- Added temporary routing fallback to eu-west for high-latency requests.
Sam D: After mitigations, queue depth dropped: 12:20 -> 40, 12:30 -> 8. Error rate returned to normal by 12:35.
Jane R: I'm going to prepare RCA notes. Key timeline and evidence we need in-thread:
- 11:50-12:00 baseline metrics
- 12:01 HPA triggers scale (metrics crossing thresholds)
- 12:02 autoscaler backoff kicks in
- 12:03-12:07 image pulls and driver issues -> pods Pending
- 12:12 manual override and pre-warm
- 12:20 stable
Kevin L: We should attach kubelet logs, autoscaler logs, registry throttling alerts, and kernel traces.
Sam D: For the RCA root cause, propose: regression in autoscaler backoff policy combined with registry/image pull throttling resulted in delayed node provisioning and prolonged warmup; GPU driver instability aggravated pod readiness. Action items:
- Roll back backoff policy to previous heuristics (ops-rotation) - owner: Jane R - priority P0 until next morning.
- Add proactive image pre-pulls to spare pool before predicted bursts - owner: Kevin L - P1
- Add HPA->node provisioning health signal to alert earlier when scale-up not completing - owner: Sam D - P1
- Postmortem doc draft due EOD 1d - owner: Maria V
Maria V: I'll coordinate comms with support. We need customer lists and impact windows for billing/credits.
Sam D: Handoff: I'm handing to ops-rotation for overnight monitoring. Key things: verify rollback is staged, monitor queue depth pipelines, confirm pre-pull is scheduled.
ops-rotation: Ack. Taking over. Will post a followup pulse at 02:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated at 12:35 UTC. Create postmortem and tag @pgm-leads.
Sam D: Thanks team. I'll paste collected logs into the incident doc.
Jane R: Putting RCA skeleton into doc now. Please add your notes inline.
 Maria V: Adding customer impact table and support messages.
Kevin L: Leaving a final note: check next week's canary policy for autoscaler; promote slower after manual verification.
Sam D: Final: incident closed for on-call. Last message from oncall thread.
